svg.title: MTP effect at 65k context
svg.desc: One matched setup: MTP reduced full prompt throughput by 12.4 percent and raised cached follow-up generation speed by 8.7 percent. The follow-up lengths differ and MTP left about 0.12 GB of container memory.
svg.text: MTP n=1: mixed result, little memory headroom
Change versus no MTP. Separate nasone32 fork, q4_0 KV, ubatch 256; one pair.
Follow-up lengths differ: 169 vs 160 tokens. About 0.12 GB container memory remained with MTP.
